record.official_identifier: Law No. 230-VIII ZRK (№ 230-VIII ЗРК) of 17 November 2025
record.summary: Framework AI law. It defines an AI system as a digital object working on one or more AI models and sets principles including fairness, transparency and explainability, responsibility and controllability, priority of human well-being, and safety. Systems are classed by risk and by autonomy. It bans creating or operating systems with prohibited capabilities, among them manipulative or subliminal techniques, exploiting vulnerabilities, social scoring, biometric categorisation for discrimination and emotion recognition without consent. Owners and holders must manage risks; users must be told when goods or services use AI, and synthetic outputs must carry machine-readable labels.
record.notes: Signed on 17 Nov 2025, together with a companion law amending other legislative acts on AI and digitalisation. That companion law aligns existing laws with the AI Law and also covers digital assets, personal-data consent and information security. Under Article 31 the law enters into force 60 calendar days after the day of its first official publication. Amended by Law No. 326-VIII of 24 Jun 2026 (Articles 1, 13, 17, 20 and 28), which also enters into force 60 calendar days after its first official publication. High-risk systems classed as critically important digital objects are treated like state systems for cybersecurity; sectoral agencies publish lists of trusted high-risk systems, for which an audit is required. Works created with AI are protected by copyright only where a human made a creative contribution, and works may be used for training only if the author or rightholder has not objected in machine-readable form.

verification.note: Stored on 16 Oct 2026: the law's Russian text on Әділет, the legal information system of the Institute of Legislation and Legal Information of the Ministry of Justice (old.adilet.zan.kz; consolidated text with the amendment footnotes), which gives the number, the date, Article 31 on entry into force and the provisions summarised; the summary is written from it. Stored on 11 Oct 2026: the Akorda (Presidential Office) notices of 17 Nov 2025 on the signing of this law and of the companion amendments law. The Әділет information, history and English pages, and the announcement of entry into force by the Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development (gov.kz, a JavaScript shell), could not be stored, so the date of first official publication, the exact date of entry into force and the adopting body are not confirmed from a stored source; date_in_force stays empty. The English title is a rendering of the Russian title; Әділет's English text, marked as an unofficial translation, was not stored. Earlier notes said Kazakhstan created a Ministry of Artificial Intelligence and Digital Development in 2025; no source for it was stored for this record.

changes.safety_topics: 'risk-based classification' added for the minimal, medium and high risk classes of Article 17(1)
changes.notes: the commencement rule (Article 31) and the 2026 amendment added from the text, and the provisions on high-risk systems, audit and copyright; research remarks removed ('reportedly', 'assumes', 'could not be fetched', 'Uzbekistan and other Central Asian states were not covered', 'referenced on primeminister.kz')

judgment.status_reasoning: Article 31 (Әділет text stored 16 Oct 2026): the law enters into force 60 calendar days after the day of its first official publication. The Akorda notice of 17 Nov 2025 records the signature and says 'Текст Закона публикуется в печати' (the text is being published in the press), so publication followed the signature in November 2025 and the 60 days ran out in January 2026, long before today (16 Oct 2026). The consolidated text on Әділет also carries amendments of 24 Jun 2026 to the law. So 'In force' stands. The exact date of entry into force needs the date of first publication, which is not in a stored file; date_in_force stays null.
